source.text: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֡ןבָּ֣אוּ בְנֵי־מוֹאָב֩ וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן וְעִמָּהֶ֧ם׀מֵֽהָעַמּוֹנִ֛ים עַל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after so, came [the] sons of Moab and [the] sons of Ammon and with them some of the Ammonites against Jehoshaphat for battle.

en.L: And it happened after this [that] the sons of Moab and the sons of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat for battle.
en.B: After this the Moabites and the Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war on Jehoshaphat.
en.R: Some time later the armies of Moab and Ammon came to fight against Jehoshaphat. Some of the Meunites came with them.

es.L: Y sucedió después de esto [que] los hijos de Moab y los hijos de Amón, y con ellos algunos de los meunitas, vinieron contra Josafat para la guerra.
es.B: Después de esto, los moabitas y los amonitas, junto con algunos de los meunitas, vinieron a hacer la guerra contra Josafat.
es.R: Algún tiempo después, los ejércitos de Moab y de Amón vinieron a pelear contra Josafat. Algunos de los meunitas venían con ellos.

fr.L: Et il arriva après cela [que] les fils de Moab et les fils d’Ammon, et avec eux quelques-uns des Méounites, vinrent contre Josaphat pour la guerre.
fr.B: Après cela, les Moabites et les Ammonites, avec quelques Méounites, vinrent faire la guerre à Josaphat.
fr.R: Quelque temps plus tard, les armées de Moab et d’Ammon sont venues attaquer Josaphat. Des Méounites sont venus avec elles.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya haya, wana wa Moabu na wana wa Amoni, na pamoja nao baadhi ya Wameuni, wakaja kupigana vita na Yehoshafati.
sw.B: Baada ya haya Wamoabu na Waamoni, pamoja na baadhi ya Wameuni, walikuja kupigana vita na Yehoshafati.
sw.R: Baada ya muda, majeshi ya Moabu na Amoni yalikuja kupigana na Yehoshafati. Baadhi ya Wameuni walikuja pamoja nao.

vi.L: Sau việc ấy, con cháu Mô-áp và con cháu Am-môn, cùng với họ có một số người Mê-u-nim, kéo đến đánh Giô-sa-phát.
vi.B: Sau việc ấy, người Mô-áp và người Am-môn, cùng với một số người Mê-u-nim, kéo đến giao chiến với Giô-sa-phát.
vi.R: Ít lâu sau, quân Mô-áp và quân Am-môn kéo đến đánh Giô-sa-phát. Có một số người Mê-u-nim đi theo họ.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일 뒤에 모압 자손과 암몬 자손이, 그리고 그들과 함께 마온 사람들 가운데 몇몇이 여호사밧과 싸우려고 왔다.
ko.B: 이 일 뒤에 모압 사람들과 암몬 사람들이 마온 사람들 일부와 함께 여호사밧과 전쟁을 하려고 쳐들어왔다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 모압과 암몬의 군대가 여호사밧과 싸우려고 쳐들어왔다. 마온 사람들 가운데 몇몇도 그들과 함께 왔다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, depois disto, [que] os filhos de Moabe e os filhos de Amom, e com eles alguns dos meunitas, vieram contra Josafá para a guerra.
pt.B: Depois disso, os moabitas e os amonitas, junto com alguns dos meunitas, vieram fazer guerra contra Josafá.
pt.R: Algum tempo depois, os exércitos de Moabe e de Amom vieram lutar contra Josafá. Alguns dos meunitas vieram com eles.

am.L: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የሞዓብ ልጆችና የአሞን ልጆች፣ ከእነርሱም ጋር ከምዑናውያን አንዳንዶቹ ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ።
am.B: ከዚህ በኋላ ሞዓባውያንና አሞናውያን ከአንዳንድ ምዑናውያን ጋር ሆነው ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ።
am.R: ከጥቂት ጊዜ በኋላ የሞዓብና የአሞን ሠራዊት ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ። ከምዑናውያንም አንዳንዶቹ ከእነርሱ ጋር መጡ።

hi.L: और इसके बाद ऐसा हुआ [कि] मोआब के पुत्र और अम्मोन के पुत्र, और उनके साथ कुछ मूनी, यहोशापात से युद्ध करने आए।
hi.B: इसके बाद मोआबी और अम्मोनी, और उनके साथ कुछ मूनी भी, यहोशापात से युद्ध करने आए।
hi.R: कुछ समय बाद मोआब और अम्मोन की सेनाएँ यहोशापात से लड़ने आईं। कुछ मूनी भी उनके साथ आए।

ru.L: И было после этого: пришли сыны Моава и сыны Аммона, и с ними [некоторые] из меунитян, против Иосафата на войну.
ru.B: После этого моавитяне и аммонитяне, а с ними некоторые из меунитян, пошли войной на Иосафата.
ru.R: Через некоторое время войска Моава и Аммона пришли воевать против Иосафата. С ними пришли и некоторые меунитяне.

ja.L: その後、こういうことがあった。モアブの子らとアンモンの子ら、および彼らと共にメウニム人のある者たちが、戦うためにヨシャファトに向かって来た。
ja.B: この後、モアブ人とアンモン人が、メウニム人の一部と共に、ヨシャファトに戦いを仕掛けて来た。
ja.R: しばらくして、モアブとアンモンの軍隊が、ヨシャファトと戦うためにやって来ました。メウニム人の一部も、彼らと一緒に来ました。

uk.L: І сталося після цього, [що] сини Моава і сини Аммона, а з ними дехто з меунітів, прийшли на Йосафата до бою.
uk.B: Після цього моавітяни й аммонітяни разом з деякими меунітами прийшли воювати з Йосафатом.
uk.R: Через якийсь час війська Моава і Аммона прийшли воювати проти Йосафата. З ними прийшли й деякі меуніти.

decisions.choice: some of the Meunites
alternatives: some of the Ammonites (the Hebrew text as written)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "some of the Ammonites", which repeats the Ammonites just named. The ancient Greek translation has the Meunites, a people who lived near Mount Seir (26:7; 1 Chronicles 4:41). In Hebrew the two names differ only in the order of two letters, so a copyist could easily confuse them. Verses 10, 22 and 23 name the people of Mount Seir as the third group in the attack, which fits the Meunites.

decisions.choice: after this: after Jehoshaphat's reforms
decisions.reason: "After this" ties the invasion to chapter 19, where Jehoshaphat brought the people back to Yahweh and set judges in the land (19:4-11). The king who has just been faithful now faces a crisis.

decisions.choice: Moab and Ammon: nations east of the Jordan and the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab lay east of the Dead Sea and Ammon to its north-east. Both were counted as descendants of Lot (Genesis 19:37-38), and Israel had been told not to take their land (Deuteronomy 2:9, 19).

decisions.choice: the Moabites and the Ammonites (Balanced); the armies of Moab and Ammon (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sons of Moab" and "sons of Ammon", the Hebrew way of naming a people. Balanced names the peoples; Readable says "armies", since they came to fight.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Moab y los hijos de Amón" (L); "los moabitas y los amonitas" (B); "los ejércitos de Moab y de Amón" (R); "los meunitas"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "sons of", Balanced names the peoples and Readable their armies, as the English levels do. "Meunitas" is the usual Spanish form for the people the English reads with the Greek (m1).

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable
decisions.reason: As the French style guide and the Kings and Chronicles terms note set for these books; speech keeps the tenses of speech. Recorded once for 2 Chronicles 20-36.

decisions.choice: "Méounites"
decisions.reason: The people the meaning decision follows (m1), in the French form with ou for the Hebrew u, as "Azouba" and "Houlda".

decisions.choice: Wameuni
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the English text decision (m1) and names the Meunites with the people prefix wa-, as it does Waamoni and Wamoabu.

decisions.choice: "người Mê-u-nim"
decisions.reason: The people named in the ancient Greek reading the English follows (m1); Vietnamese gives the name in the usual transliteration with "người" for a people.

decisions.choice: "마온 사람들" for the Meunites
decisions.reason: The Korean form follows the English reading of the Greek (m1) and the town name Maon, from which the people are usually thought to take their name; the same form is used at 26:7.

decisions.choice: os meunitas
decisions.reason: The English follows the reading the meaning note explains (m1), and so does the Portuguese, with the people's name as 1 Chronicles 4:41 writes it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in this chapter's Amharic (Jehoshaphat's prayer, verses 6-12, and verses 18, 20, 21)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: the Meunites "ምዑናውያን" (new), following the meaning decision; the sons of Moab and Ammon "የሞዓብ ልጆችና የአሞን ልጆች" (Literal), "ሞዓባውያንና አሞናውያን" (Balanced), as Deuteronomy 2 and 1 Kings 11
decisions.reason: The Hebrew as written repeats "Ammonites"; the meaning decision reads Meunites, as the English does, and the Amharic follows it. The people names keep the forms on main.
The Meunites, as the English reads (meaning m1) and as 1 Chronicles 4:41 in this translation; "the sons of Moab" is "मोआब के पुत्र" at Literal, as 1 Chronicles 19:1 has "अम्मोन के पुत्रों".

decisions.choice: "меунитяне"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text repeats "Ammonites" here; this translation follows the reading "Meunites" (meaning decision), in the form used at 1 Chronicles 4:41.

decisions.choice: bene Mo'av / bene Ammon "モアブの子ら・アンモンの子ら" (L), "モアブ人・アンモン人" (B); Meunites "メウニム人", as 1 Chronicles 4:41, following the English reading.
decisions.reason: Settled forms for the peoples; the text-variant is in the meaning decision.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָט֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֣א עָלֶ֜יךָ הָמ֥וֹן רָ֛ב מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם מֵאֲרָ֑ם וְהִנָּם֙ בְּחַֽצְצ֣וֹן תָּמָ֔ר הִ֖יא עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And came [people] and told Jehoshaphat, saying, is coming against you a multitude great from beyond the sea, from Aram; and behold, they [are] in Hazazon-tamar, that [is] En-gedi.

en.L: And [some] came and told Jehoshaphat, saying, "A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea, from Edom; and see, they [are] in Hazazon-tamar, that [is] En-gedi."
en.B: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, "A great army is coming against you from beyond the Dead Sea, from Edom. They are already at Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi."
en.R: Messengers came and told Jehoshaphat, "A huge army is coming to attack you. They are coming from Edom, on the other side of the Dead Sea. They are already at Hazazon-tamar, the town of En-gedi."

es.L: Y [algunos] vinieron y avisaron a Josafat, diciendo: «Una gran multitud viene contra ti desde el otro lado del mar, desde Edom; y he aquí, [están] en Hazezón-tamar, que [es] En-gadi».
es.B: Unos hombres vinieron y le avisaron a Josafat: «Un gran ejército viene contra ti desde el otro lado del mar Muerto, desde Edom. Ya están en Hazezón-tamar, que es En-gadi».
es.R: Unos mensajeros vinieron y le dijeron a Josafat: «Un ejército enorme viene a atacarte. Viene de Edom, del otro lado del mar Muerto. Ya está en Hazezón-tamar, es decir, en el pueblo de En-gadi».

fr.L: Et [des gens] vinrent et informèrent Josaphat, disant : « Une grande multitude vient contre toi d’au-delà de la mer, d’Édom ; et voici, ils [sont] à Hatsatson-Tamar, c’[est]-à-[dire] En-Guédi. »
fr.B: Des hommes vinrent avertir Josaphat : « Une grande armée marche contre toi d’au-delà de la mer Morte, d’Édom. Ils sont déjà à Hatsatson-Tamar, c’est-à-dire En-Guédi. »
fr.R: Des messagers sont venus dire à Josaphat : « Une énorme armée vient t’attaquer. Elle vient d’Édom, de l’autre côté de la mer Morte. Ils sont déjà à Hatsatson-Tamar, c’est-à-dire la ville d’En-Guédi. »

sw.L: Wakaja [watu] wakamwambia Yehoshafati, wakisema, "Umati mkubwa unakuja juu yako kutoka ng'ambo ya bahari, kutoka Edomu; na tazama, wako Hazazon-tamari, ndio En-gedi."
sw.B: Watu fulani walikuja wakamwambia Yehoshafati, "Jeshi kubwa linakuja kukushambulia kutoka ng'ambo ya Bahari ya Chumvi, kutoka Edomu. Tayari wako Hazazon-tamari, yaani En-gedi."
sw.R: Wajumbe walikuja wakamwambia Yehoshafati, "Jeshi kubwa sana linakuja kukushambulia. Linatoka Edomu, upande wa pili wa Bahari Mfu. Tayari wamefika Hazazon-tamari, mji wa En-gedi."

vi.L: Có người đến báo cho Giô-sa-phát rằng: "Một đoàn người đông đảo từ bên kia biển, từ Ê-đôm, đang kéo đến đánh vua; kìa, họ [đang ở] Ha-xa-xôn Tha-ma, tức là Ên-ghê-đi."
vi.B: Có mấy người đến báo cho Giô-sa-phát: "Một đạo quân lớn từ bên kia Biển Chết, từ Ê-đôm, đang kéo đến đánh bệ hạ. Họ đã đến Ha-xa-xôn Tha-ma, tức là Ên-ghê-đi."
vi.R: Có những người đưa tin đến báo cho Giô-sa-phát: "Một đạo quân rất đông đang kéo đến tấn công đức vua. Họ từ Ê-đôm đến, ở bên kia Biển Chết. Họ đã đến Ha-xa-xôn Tha-ma, tức là thị trấn Ên-ghê-đi."

ko.L: 그리고 [사람들이] 와서 여호사밧에게 알려 말했다. "큰 무리가 바다 건너편에서, 에돔에서 임금님을 치러 오고 있습니다. 보십시오, 그들이 하사손다말, 곧 엔게디에 [있습니다]."
ko.B: 사람들이 와서 여호사밧에게 알렸다. "사해 건너편 에돔에서 큰 군대가 임금님을 치러 오고 있습니다. 그들은 벌써 하사손다말, 곧 엔게디에 와 있습니다."
ko.R: 전령들이 와서 여호사밧에게 알렸다. "엄청나게 큰 군대가 임금님을 치러 오고 있습니다. 그들은 사해 건너편 에돔에서 오고 있습니다. 벌써 엔게디 성읍인 하사손다말까지 와 있습니다."

pt.L: E vieram [alguns] e anunciaram a Josafá, dizendo: "Uma grande multidão vem contra o senhor, de além do mar, de Edom; e eis que eles [estão] em Hazazom-Tamar, que [é] En-Gedi."
pt.B: Alguns homens vieram e avisaram Josafá: "Um grande exército vem contra o senhor, do outro lado do mar Morto, de Edom. Eles já estão em Hazazom-Tamar, que é En-Gedi."
pt.R: Uns mensageiros vieram e disseram a Josafá: "Um exército enorme está vindo atacar o senhor. Eles vêm de Edom, do outro lado do mar Morto. Já estão em Hazazom-Tamar, a cidade de En-Gedi."

am.L: [ሰዎችም] መጥተው ለኢዮሣፍጥ እንዲህ ብለው ነገሩት፦ «ከባሕሩ ማዶ ከኤዶም እጅግ ብዙ ሕዝብ ሊወጋህ መጥቷል፤ እነሆም፣ በሐጸጾንታማር፣ ይኸውም በዓይንጋዲ፣ ናቸው።»
am.B: አንዳንድ ሰዎች መጥተው ለኢዮሣፍጥ እንዲህ ብለው ነገሩት፦ «ከሙት ባሕር ማዶ ከኤዶም ታላቅ ሠራዊት ሊወጋህ መጥቷል። እነርሱም አሁን በሐጸጾንታማር፣ ይኸውም በዓይንጋዲ፣ ደርሰዋል።»
am.R: መልእክተኞች መጥተው ለኢዮሣፍጥ እንዲህ ብለው ነገሩት፦ «እጅግ ብዙ ሠራዊት ሊወጋህ እየመጣ ነው። የሚመጡትም ከሙት ባሕር ማዶ ካለችው ከኤዶም ነው። አሁንም ዓይንጋዲ በምትባለው ከተማ በሐጸጾንታማር ደርሰዋል።»

hi.L: और [कुछ लोगों ने] आकर यहोशापात को बताया, "समुद्र के पार से, एदोम से, एक बड़ी भीड़ आप पर चढ़ी आ रही है; और देखिए, वे हससोन-तामार में, अर्थात् एनगदी में, [हैं]।"
hi.B: कुछ लोगों ने आकर यहोशापात को बताया, "मृत सागर के पार से, एदोम से, एक विशाल सेना आप पर चढ़ी आ रही है। वे हससोन-तामार तक, अर्थात् एनगदी तक, पहुँच चुके हैं।"
hi.R: दूतों ने आकर यहोशापात को बताया, "एक बहुत बड़ी सेना आप पर हमला करने आ रही है। वे मृत सागर के उस पार, एदोम से आ रहे हैं। वे हससोन-तामार, अर्थात् एनगदी नगर, तक पहुँच चुके हैं।"

ru.L: И пришли и сообщили Иосафату, говоря: «Идёт против тебя великое множество из-за моря, из Едома; и вот, они в Хацецон-Фамаре, это Ен-Гадди.»
ru.B: Пришли люди и сообщили Иосафату: «Против тебя идёт огромное войско из-за Мёртвого моря, из Едома. Они уже в Хацецон-Фамаре, то есть в Ен-Гадди.»
ru.R: К Иосафату пришли вестники и сказали: «Огромное войско идёт напасть на тебя. Они идут из Едома, с другой стороны Мёртвого моря. Они уже в Хацецон-Фамаре, в городе Ен-Гадди.»

ja.L: そして[人々が]来て、ヨシャファトに告げて言った。「大軍が海の向こうから、エドムから、あなたに向かって来ています。そして見てください、彼らはハツェツォン・タマル、すなわちエン・ゲディにいます。」
ja.B: ある人々が来て、ヨシャファトに告げた。「大軍が死海の向こうから、エドムから、王さまを攻めに来ています。彼らはもう、ハツェツォン・タマル、すなわちエン・ゲディにいます。」
ja.R: 使いの者たちが来て、ヨシャファトに知らせました。「大軍が王さまを攻めに来ます。死海の向こう側のエドムから来るのです。もう、ハツェツォン・タマル、つまりエン・ゲディの町まで来ています。」

uk.L: І прийшли [дехто] і сповістили Йосафатові, кажучи: «Іде на тебе велика сила з-за моря, з Едому; і ось вони в Хацецон-Тамарі, тобто в Ен-Геді.»
uk.B: Дехто прийшов і сповістив Йосафатові: «Велике військо йде на тебе з-за Мертвого моря, з Едому. Вони вже в Хацецон-Тамарі, тобто в Ен-Геді.»
uk.R: Посланці прийшли й сказали Йосафатові: «Величезне військо йде напасти на тебе. Вони йдуть з Едому, з другого боку Мертвого моря. Вони вже в Хацецон-Тамарі, у місті Ен-Геді.»

decisions.choice: from Edom
alternatives: from Aram (the Hebrew text as written)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "from Aram", the kingdom of the Arameans north-east of Israel. In Hebrew writing the names Aram and Edom differ by one letter, and the two letters (r and d) look very much alike; copyists confused the names elsewhere (2 Kings 16:6). An army that comes "from beyond the sea" to En-gedi comes round the Dead Sea from the east or south, where Edom and Mount Seir lie, and verses 10 and 22 name Mount Seir among the invaders.

decisions.choice: beyond the sea: from the far side of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: "The sea" here is the Dead Sea, called the Salt Sea in the law (Numbers 34:3). The invaders came from its eastern or southern side.

decisions.choice: Hazazon-tamar, that is En-gedi: an oasis on the west shore of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: En-gedi was a spring and oasis on the western shore of the Dead Sea, about 25 miles south-east of Jerusalem. Hazazon-tamar ("Hazazon of the palm trees") was its older name (Genesis 14:7). From there a road climbed into the hills of Judah.

decisions.choice: a great multitude: a huge army
decisions.reason: The word means a crowd or throng, often of soldiers (14:10; 1 Kings 20:13). It returns in verses 12, 15 and 24.

decisions.choice: the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the sea (m2) so that readers know which one is meant.

decisions.choice: Hazazon-tamar
decisions.reason: The place is spelled here as in Genesis 14:7, where it is the same town; the Hebrew spelling here differs slightly. Readable adds "the town of" to make clear that En-gedi is the same place.

decisions.choice: "Hazezón-tamar", "En-gadi"; "el mar Muerto" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The place names as published Genesis 14:7 and 1 Samuel 24:1 spell them; Balanced and Readable name the Dead Sea, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: "Hatsatson-Tamar", "En-Guédi"
decisions.reason: The forms already used in French Genesis 14:7 and 1 Samuel 24:1, where the same places are named.

decisions.choice: Bahari ya Chumvi (B); Bahari Mfu (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "Bahari ya Chumvi", the Salt Sea of the law (Numbers 34:3); Readable says "Bahari Mfu", the Readable name for the Dead Sea settled in Joshua–Ruth and used in Deuteronomy, Joshua and 2 Kings 14:25.

decisions.choice: messengers call the king "vua" (L), "bệ hạ" (B), "đức vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms notes' address to a king, recorded once in this block; subjects call themselves "đầy tớ" (L, B) and "tôi" (R).

decisions.choice: "임금님" for "you" addressed to the king, in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Subjects speak to the king in 합쇼체 and call him 임금님, as in Samuel and Kings; Korean does not address a king as "당신".

decisions.choice: o senhor (the messengers to the king); Hazazom-Tamar; En-Gedi
decisions.reason: Subjects speak up to their king with "o senhor", as in Samuel and Kings in Portuguese. The place names keep the forms of Genesis 14:7 and 1 Samuel 24:1 in Portuguese (m3).

decisions.choice: from Edom "ከኤዶም", following the meaning decision; the sea "ባሕሩ" (Literal), "ሙት ባሕር" (Balanced, Readable), as the Salt Sea is settled; Hazazon-tamar "ሐጸጾንታማር" (Genesis 14:7), En-gedi "ዓይንጋዲ" (1 Samuel 24:1); multitude (hamon) "እጅግ ብዙ ሕዝብ" (Literal), "ሠራዊት" (Balanced, Readable), here and in verses 12, 15 and 24
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads Edom where the Hebrew as written has Aram; the place names keep the forms on main.

decisions.choice: "एदोम"; "हससोन-तामार"; "एनगदी"
decisions.reason: Edom as the English reads (meaning m1); Hazazon-tamar as Genesis 14:7 and En-gedi as elsewhere in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Хацецон-Фамар"; "Ен-Гадди"
decisions.reason: The place is spelled as in Genesis 14:7 and En-gedi as in Joshua 15:62, as the English does; Balanced and Readable name the Dead Sea, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Hazazon-tamar "ハツェツォン・タマル", En-gedi "エン・ゲディ" (as 1 Samuel); the messengers speak politely, "王さま" at Balanced and Readable for the Hebrew "you".
decisions.reason: Subjects address the king with です・ます and 王さま.

source.text: וַיִּרָ֕א וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אֶת־פָּנָ֖יו לִדְר֣וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָא־צ֖וֹם עַל־כָּל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was afraid and set Jehoshaphat his face to seek Yahweh, and proclaimed a fast over all Judah.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat was afraid, and he set his face to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
en.B: Jehoshaphat was afraid, and he resolved to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He proclaimed a fast for all Judah.
en.R: Jehoshaphat was frightened, and he made up his mind to ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help. He told everyone in Judah to fast, to go without food.

es.L: Y Josafat tuvo miedo, y puso su rostro en buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y proclamó ayuno en todo Judá.
es.B: Josafat tuvo miedo y se propuso buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Proclamó un ayuno para todo Judá.
es.R: Josafat se asustó y decidió pedirle ayuda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Ordenó que todos en Judá ayunaran, es decir, que no comieran nada.

fr.L: Et Josaphat eut peur, et il tourna sa face pour chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il proclama un jeûne dans tout Juda.
fr.B: Josaphat eut peur, et il résolut de chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il proclama un jeûne pour tout Juda.
fr.R: Josaphat a été effrayé, et il a décidé de demander de l’aide {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il a demandé à tous les habitants de Juda de jeûner, c’est-à-dire de ne pas manger.

sw.L: Naye Yehoshafati akaogopa, akauelekeza uso wake kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akatangaza mfungo katika Yuda yote.
sw.B: Yehoshafati aliogopa, akaamua kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akatangaza mfungo kwa Yuda yote.
sw.R: Yehoshafati aliingiwa na hofu, akaamua kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} msaada. Akawaambia watu wote wa Yuda wafunge, yaani wasile chakula.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát sợ hãi, và ông quyết tâm tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi ông công bố một kỳ kiêng ăn khắp cả Giu-đa.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát sợ hãi và quyết lòng tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua công bố cho cả Giu-đa kiêng ăn.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát rất sợ, và vua quyết định cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ. Vua bảo mọi người trong Giu-đa phải kiêng ăn, nghĩa là nhịn đói để cầu nguyện.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 두려워하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 그의 얼굴을 정하고, 온 유다에 금식을 선포했다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 두려워서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾기로 마음을 굳게 정하고, 온 유다에 금식을 선포했다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 겁이 났다. 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도움을 구하기로 마음먹었다. 그는 유다의 모든 사람에게 음식을 먹지 말고 금식하라고 명령했다.

pt.L: E Josafá teve medo, e voltou o seu rosto para buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e proclamou um jejum em todo o Judá.
pt.B: Josafá teve medo e decidiu buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ele proclamou um jejum para todo o Judá.
pt.R: Josafá ficou com medo e resolveu pedir ajuda {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Ele mandou que todo o povo de Judá jejuasse, isto é, ficasse sem comer.

am.L: ኢዮሣፍጥም ፈራ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ይፈልግ ዘንድ ፊቱን አቀና፤ በይሁዳም ሁሉ ጾም አወጀ።
am.B: ኢዮሣፍጥ ፈራ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለመፈለግም ቆረጠ። በይሁዳ ሁሉ ጾም አወጀ።
am.R: ኢዮሣፍጥ ደነገጠ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እርዳታ ለመጠየቅም ወሰነ። በይሁዳ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ምግብ ሳይበሉ እንዲጾሙ አዘዘ።

hi.L: और यहोशापात डर गया, और उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजने के लिए अपना मुँह लगाया, और सारे यहूदा में उपवास का प्रचार किया।
hi.B: यहोशापात डर गया, और उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजने का निश्चय किया। उसने सारे यहूदा के लिए उपवास की घोषणा की।
hi.R: यहोशापात घबरा गया, और उसने ठान लिया कि वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से सहायता माँगेगा। उसने यहूदा के सब लोगों से कहा कि वे उपवास करें, अर्थात् भोजन न करें।

ru.L: И убоялся Иосафат, и обратил своё лицо к тому, чтобы искать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и объявил пост во всём Иуде.
ru.B: Иосафат испугался и решил обратиться к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Он объявил пост для всего Иуды.
ru.R: Иосафат испугался и решил просить помощи у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Он велел всем жителям Иуды поститься — не есть ничего.

ja.L: そしてヨシャファトは恐れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めることに顔を向け、ユダ全体に断食を布告した。
ja.B: ヨシャファトは恐れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めようと決意した。そして、ユダ全体に断食を布告した。
ja.R: ヨシャファトはこわくなり、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に助けを求めようと心に決めました。そして、ユダの人々全員に、断食するように、つまり食事をしないように命じました。

uk.L: І злякався Йосафат, і звернув своє обличчя, щоб шукати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і оголосив піст по всьому Юді.
uk.B: Йосафат злякався і вирішив шукати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Він оголосив піст для всього Юди.
uk.R: Йосафат злякався і твердо вирішив просити допомоги в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Він звелів усім у Юді постити, тобто не їсти.

decisions.choice: set his face to seek: turned his whole attention to seeking
decisions.reason: To set one's face toward something is to resolve on it. Jehoshaphat's fear did not lead him to panic but to turn to Yahweh.

decisions.choice: to seek Yahweh: to turn to him in prayer for help
decisions.reason: Seeking Yahweh is a key phrase in Chronicles for turning to him in trust and asking his help (7:14; 15:2, 12). Jehoshaphat had done so from the start of his reign (17:4; 19:3).

decisions.choice: a fast: going without food as a sign of humbling and urgent prayer
decisions.reason: Israel fasted in times of danger and grief, to humble themselves before God and to plead with him (Judges 20:26; 1 Samuel 7:6).

decisions.choice: ask the LORD for help; to go without food
decisions.reason: Readable says what "seek" means here (m2) and explains what a fast is (m3).

decisions.choice: "puso su rostro en buscar" (L); "se propuso buscar" (B); "decidió pedirle ayuda" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of setting the face; Balanced and Readable give the resolve it means (m1), and Readable says what "seek" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: kumtafuta BWANA
decisions.reason: "Seek the LORD", a key phrase of Chronicles, is "kumtafuta BWANA" at Literal and Balanced through these chapters; Readable says what the seeking is here, "kumwomba BWANA msaada" (m2).

decisions.choice: "quyết tâm" for "set his face"
decisions.reason: "Hướng mặt" would be read as turning to look; Vietnamese says the resolve the idiom means (m1) at every level.

decisions.choice: "그의 얼굴을 정하고" (Literal); "마음을 굳게 정하고" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of setting the face; Balanced and Readable give its sense, resolving (m1).

decisions.choice: buscar (L, B); pedir ajuda (R)
decisions.reason: "Buscar" is the Chronicler's word for seeking the LORD (m2), as 1:5 sets it for the book; Readable says what it means here, as the English does, and explains the fast (m3).

source.text: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֔ה לְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽיְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם מִכָּל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered Judah to seek from Yahweh; even from all [the] cities of Judah they came to seek Yahweh.

en.L: And Judah gathered together to seek [help] from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; even from all the cities of Judah they came to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The people of Judah gathered to seek help from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; they came from every town in Judah to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The people of Judah came together to ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help. They came from every town in Judah to turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Judá se reunió para buscar [ayuda] {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; también de todas las ciudades de Judá vinieron a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: La gente de Judá se reunió para buscar ayuda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; de todas las ciudades de Judá vinieron a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: La gente de Judá se reunió para pedirle ayuda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Vinieron de todas las ciudades de Judá para volverse {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Juda se rassembla pour chercher [du secours] auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; même de toutes les villes de Juda ils vinrent pour chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les gens de Juda se rassemblèrent pour chercher du secours auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; ils vinrent de toutes les villes de Juda pour chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les gens de Juda se sont réunis pour demander de l’aide {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Ils sont venus de toutes les villes de Juda pour se tourner vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Yuda wakakusanyika ili kutafuta [msaada] kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hata kutoka miji yote ya Yuda walikuja kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watu wa Yuda walikusanyika kutafuta msaada kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; walikuja kutoka kila mji wa Yuda kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda walikusanyika ili kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} msaada. Walikuja kutoka kila mji wa Yuda ili kumgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Giu-đa nhóm lại để tìm kiếm [sự giúp đỡ] từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; họ đến từ mọi thành của Giu-đa để tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Người Giu-đa nhóm lại để cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ; họ đến từ mọi thành của Giu-đa để tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa họp nhau lại để xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ. Họ từ mọi thành trong Giu-đa kéo đến để tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [도움을] 구하려고 모였다. 유다의 모든 성읍에서도 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾으려고 왔다.
ko.B: 유다 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도움을 구하려고 모여들었다. 유다의 모든 성읍에서 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾으려고 왔다.
ko.R: 유다 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 빌려고 모였다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 매달리려고 유다의 모든 성읍에서 왔다.

pt.L: E Judá se reuniu para buscar [ajuda] {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; também de todas as cidades de Judá vieram para buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: O povo de Judá se reuniu para buscar a ajuda {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; de todas as cidades de Judá vieram para buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: O povo de Judá se reuniu para pedir ajuda {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Vieram de todas as cidades de Judá para se voltar para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ይሁዳም {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} [እርዳታ] ሊፈልጉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ እንኳ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሊፈልጉ መጡ።
am.B: የይሁዳ ሕዝብ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} እርዳታ ሊፈልጉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሊፈልጉ ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ መጡ።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሕዝብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እርዳታ ለመጠየቅ ተሰበሰቡ። ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለመመለስ ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ መጡ።

hi.L: और यहूदा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से [सहायता] माँगने को इकट्ठा हुआ; यहूदा के सब नगरों से भी वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजने आए।
hi.B: यहूदा के लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से सहायता माँगने को इकट्ठे हुए; वे यहूदा के हर नगर से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को खोजने आए।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से सहायता माँगने के लिए इकट्ठे हुए। वे यहूदा के हर नगर से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर फिरने आए।

ru.L: И собрался Иуда искать [помощи] от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; и из всех городов Иуды пришли искать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Жители Иуды собрались, чтобы просить помощи у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; из всех городов Иуды пришли они искать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Жители Иуды собрались вместе, чтобы просить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} о помощи. Из всех городов Иуды пришли люди, чтобы обратиться к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そしてユダは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から[助けを]求めるために集まった。ユダのすべての町々からも、彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めるために来た。
ja.B: ユダの人々は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に助けを求めるために集まった。彼らはユダのすべての町から、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を求めてやって来た。
ja.R: ユダの人々は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に助けを求めるために集まって来ました。ユダのすべての町から、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に頼ろうとしてやって来たのです。

uk.L: І зібрався Юда, щоб шукати [допомоги] від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; навіть з усіх міст Юди вони прийшли шукати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Люди Юди зібралися, щоб шукати допомоги від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; вони прийшли з кожного міста в Юді, щоб шукати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Люди Юди зібралися, щоб просити допомоги в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Вони прийшли з кожного міста в Юді, щоб звернутися до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: to seek from Yahweh ... to seek Yahweh: to ask his help, and to turn to him
decisions.reason: The first phrase has "from": they came to ask something from Yahweh, his help against the invaders. The second has no "from": they came to seek Yahweh himself. The two belong together.

decisions.choice: Judah: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: The name of the land stands for its people, as often.

decisions.choice: help
decisions.reason: Literal brackets and Balanced supplies "help", the object implied by "seek from" (m1).

source.text: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט בִּקְהַ֧ל יְהוּדָ֛ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֖י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחֲדָשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And stood Jehoshaphat in [the] assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in [the] house of Yahweh, before the court the new.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in front of the new court.
en.B: Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in front of the new courtyard.
en.R: The people of Judah and Jerusalem were gathered at the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Jehoshaphat stood up in front of them, in front of the new courtyard.

es.L: Y Josafat se puso en pie en la asamblea de Judá y de Jerusalén, en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, delante del atrio nuevo.
es.B: Josafat se puso en pie en la asamblea de Judá y de Jerusalén, en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, delante del atrio nuevo.
es.R: La gente de Judá y de Jerusalén estaba reunida en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Josafat se puso de pie delante de ellos, frente al atrio nuevo.

fr.L: Et Josaphat se tint dans l’assemblée de Juda et de Jérusalem, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, devant la cour nouvelle.
fr.B: Josaphat se leva au milieu de l’assemblée de Juda et de Jérusalem, dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, devant la nouvelle cour.
fr.R: Les gens de Juda et de Jérusalem étaient réunis au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Josaphat s’est levé devant eux, devant la nouvelle cour.

sw.L: Naye Yehoshafati akasimama katika kusanyiko la Yuda na Yerusalemu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya ua mpya.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alisimama katika kusanyiko la Yuda na Yerusalemu kwenye nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya ua mpya.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu walikuwa wamekusanyika katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yehoshafati akasimama mbele yao, mbele ya ua mpya.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát đứng giữa hội chúng Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trước sân mới.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát đứng lên giữa hội chúng Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trước sân mới.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem nhóm lại tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Giô-sa-phát đứng lên trước mặt họ, phía trước sân mới.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서, 새 뜰 앞에서, 유다와 예루살렘의 회중 가운데 섰다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 새 뜰 앞에서 유다와 예루살렘의 회중 가운데 섰다.
ko.R: 유다와 예루살렘 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 모였다. 여호사밧은 새 뜰 앞에서 그들 앞에 섰다.

pt.L: E Josafá se pôs de pé na assembleia de Judá e de Jerusalém, na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, diante do pátio novo.
pt.B: Josafá se pôs de pé diante da assembleia de Judá e de Jerusalém, na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, em frente do pátio novo.
pt.R: O povo de Judá e de Jerusalém estava reunido no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Josafá se levantou diante deles, em frente do pátio novo.

am.L: ኢዮሣፍጥም በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ መካከል {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት ቆመ።
am.B: ኢዮሣፍጥ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ መካከል ቆመ።
am.R: የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ተሰብስበው ነበር። ኢዮሣፍጥም በፊታቸው፣ በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት ቆመ።

hi.L: और यहोशापात {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में, नए आँगन के सामने, यहूदा और यरूशलेम की सभा में खड़ा हुआ।
hi.B: यहोशापात {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में नए आँगन के सामने, यहूदा और यरूशलेम की सभा के बीच खड़ा हुआ।
hi.R: यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में इकट्ठे थे। यहोशापात उनके सामने, नए आँगन के सामने, खड़ा हुआ।

ru.L: И встал Иосафат в собрании Иуды и Иерусалима в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, перед новым двором.
ru.B: Иосафат встал в собрании Иуды и Иерусалима у дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, перед новым двором.
ru.R: Жители Иуды и Иерусалима собрались у храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Иосафат встал перед ними, перед новым двором.

ja.L: そしてヨシャファトは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の新しい庭の前で、ユダとエルサレムの集会の中に立った。
ja.B: ヨシャファトは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の新しい庭の前で、ユダとエルサレムの集会の中に立ち上がった。
ja.R: ユダとエルサレムの人々は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿に集まっていました。ヨシャファトは、新しい庭の前で、人々の前に立ちました。

uk.L: І став Йосафат у зібранні Юди та Єрусалиму в домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІМ|Ягве}}, перед новим двором.
uk.B: Йосафат став у зібранні Юди та Єрусалиму при домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІМ|Ягве}}, перед новим двором.
uk.R: Люди Юди та Єрусалиму зібралися при храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІМ|Ягве}}. Йосафат став перед ними, перед новим двором.

decisions.choice: the new court: a courtyard of the temple, rebuilt or newly made
decisions.reason: The text does not say which court this was. It may be the great outer court of the temple (4:9), renewed in Jehoshaphat's or Asa's time. The king stood where the gathered people could see and hear him.

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly: as Solomon did when he prayed at the temple's dedication
decisions.reason: Solomon stood before the assembly of Israel in the court of the temple and prayed (6:12-13). Jehoshaphat's prayer, which follows, calls on the promise Solomon prayed for (verse 9).

decisions.choice: two sentences; the temple
decisions.reason: Readable first says the people were gathered, then that the king stood before them. It says "temple" for "house of the LORD", as these books do.

decisions.choice: "la casa del SEÑOR" (L, B); "el templo del SEÑOR" (R); "atrio"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the house of the LORD at each level; "atrio" for the court of the temple.

decisions.choice: "nhà của CHÚA" (L, B); "đền thờ của CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for "the house of the LORD", used through this block.

decisions.choice: assembly (qahal) "ጉባኤ"; court "አደባባይ"; the house of the LORD "… ቤት" (Literal), "… ቤተ መቅደስ" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled terms for Chronicles.

source.text: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֵ֨ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֨א אַתָּֽה־ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְאַתָּ֣ה מוֹשֵׁ֔ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּבְיָדְךָ֙ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין עִמְּךָ֖ לְהִתְיַצֵּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Yahweh, God of our fathers, [are] not you he, God in the heavens? And you [are] ruling over all [the] kingdoms of the nations, and in your hand [are] power and might, and there is not with you to stand.

en.L: And he said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of our fathers, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not God in heaven? And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rule over all the kingdoms of the nations, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand [are] power and might, and [there is] no one to stand against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: He said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of our ancestors, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not God in heaven? You rule over every kingdom of the nations. In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand are power and might, and no one is able to withstand {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: He prayed, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of our ancestors, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God in heaven. You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. You are strong and mighty, and no one can stand against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de nuestros padres, ¿no eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} Dios en los cielos? Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} gobiernas sobre todos los reinos de las naciones, y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano [están] el poder y la fuerza, y no [hay] quien pueda hacer{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} frente.
es.B: Dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de nuestros antepasados, ¿no eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} Dios en el cielo? Tú gobiernas sobre todos los reinos de las naciones. En {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano están el poder y la fuerza, y nadie puede resistir{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}.
es.R: Oró así: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de nuestros antepasados, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios en el cielo. Tú gobiernas sobre todos los reinos de las naciones. Eres fuerte y poderoso, y nadie puede hacer{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} frente.

fr.L: Et il dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de nos pères, n’es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Dieu dans les cieux ? Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} domines sur tous les royaumes des nations, et dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main [sont] la force et la puissance, et [il n’y a] personne pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} résister.
fr.B: Il dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de nos ancêtres, n’es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas le Dieu qui est dans les cieux ? C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui domines sur tous les royaumes des nations. Dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main sont la force et la puissance, et personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tenir tête.
fr.R: Il a prié : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de nos ancêtres, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu qui est au ciel. Tu règnes sur tous les royaumes des nations. Tu es fort et puissant, et personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} résister.

sw.L: Akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zetu, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} si Mungu aliye mbinguni? Nawe unatawala juu ya falme zote za mataifa, na mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} [mna] uwezo na nguvu, wala hakuna [awezaye] kusimama dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zetu, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} si Mungu aliye mbinguni? Wewe unatawala falme zote za mataifa. Mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}} mna uwezo na nguvu, wala hakuna anayeweza kusimama dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Akaomba, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zetu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu aliye mbinguni. Wewe unatawala falme zote za mataifa. Wewe una uwezo na nguvu, wala hakuna mtu anayeweza kusimama dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Ông cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ chúng con, chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời ở trên trời sao? Ngài cai trị trên mọi vương quốc của các dân tộc; trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [có] quyền năng và sức mạnh, và không ai đứng nổi trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vua cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên chúng con, chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời ở trên trời sao? Ngài cai trị mọi vương quốc của các dân tộc. Trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có quyền năng và sức mạnh, và không ai có thể chống cự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vua cầu nguyện: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời ở trên trời. Ngài cai trị mọi vương quốc của các dân tộc. Ngài đầy quyền năng và sức mạnh, không ai có thể chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "저희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 하늘에 계신 하나님이 아니십니까? 주님께서 민족들의 모든 나라를 다스리십니다. 주님의 손에 힘과 능력이 [있으니], 주님께 맞설 자가 없습니다.
ko.B: 그가 말했다. "저희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 하늘에 계신 하나님이 아니십니까? 주님께서는 뭇 민족의 모든 나라를 다스리십니다. 주님의 손에 힘과 능력이 있으니, 아무도 주님을 당해 낼 수 없습니다.
ko.R: 그가 기도했다. "저희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 하늘에 계신 하나님이십니다. 주님께서는 세상 모든 민족의 나라를 다스리십니다. 주님께서는 힘이 세고 능력이 크셔서, 아무도 주님께 맞설 수 없습니다.

pt.L: E disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus dos nossos pais, não és {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Deus nos céus? E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dominas sobre todos os reinos das nações, e na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão [estão] a força e o poder, e não [há quem possa] resistir a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Ele disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus dos nossos antepassados, não és {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o Deus que está nos céus? Tu dominas sobre todos os reinos das nações. Na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão estão a força e o poder, e ninguém é capaz de resistir a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Ele orou: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus dos nossos antepassados, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o Deus que está no céu. Tu governas todos os reinos das nações. Tu tens força e poder, e ninguém pode lutar contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: እንዲህም አለ፦ «የአባቶቻችን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ አይደለህምን? በሕዝቦችም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ አንተ ትገዛለህ፤ በእጅህም ኃይልና ብርታት [አለ]፤ አንተንም ሊቋቋም የሚችል የለም።
am.B: እንዲህም አለ፦ «የአባቶቻችን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ አንተ አይደለህምን? አንተ በሕዝቦች መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ትገዛለህ። ኃይልና ብርታት በእጅህ ነው፤ አንተን ሊቋቋም የሚችል ማንም የለም።
am.R: እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፦ «የአባቶቻችን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ ነህ። በሕዝቦች መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ትገዛለህ። አንተ ብርቱና ኃያል ነህ፤ ሊቋቋምህ የሚችል ማንም የለም።

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर, क्या तू स्वर्ग में परमेश्वर नहीं है? और तू जातियों के सब राज्यों पर प्रभुता करता है, और तेरे हाथ में सामर्थ्य और पराक्रम [है], और कोई तेरे सामने टिक नहीं सकता।
hi.B: उसने कहा, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर, क्या तू स्वर्ग में परमेश्वर नहीं है? तू जातियों के हर राज्य पर शासन करता है। तेरे हाथ में सामर्थ्य और पराक्रम है, और कोई तेरा सामना नहीं कर सकता।
hi.R: उसने प्रार्थना की, "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर, तू स्वर्ग में परमेश्वर है। तू जातियों के सब राज्यों पर राज्य करता है। तू सामर्थी और पराक्रमी है, और कोई तेरे सामने खड़ा नहीं रह सकता।

ru.L: И сказал он: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Бог наших отцов, не {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ли Бог на небесах? И {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} владычествуешь над всеми царствами народов, и в {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} руке сила и могущество, и нет [никого, кто мог бы] устоять против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.B: Он сказал: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Бог наших предков, разве не {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} Бог на небесах? Ты владычествуешь над всеми царствами народов. В {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} руке сила и могущество, и никто не может устоять против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.R: Он молился: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Бог наших предков, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Бог на небесах. Ты правишь всеми царствами народов. Ты силён и могуч, и никто не может устоять против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: そして彼は言った。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしたちの先祖の神よ、あなたは天におられる神ではありませんか？あなたは諸国のすべての王国を治めておられ、あなたの手には力と勢いがあり、あなたに立ち向かうことのできる者はいません。
ja.B: 彼は言った。「わたしたちの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは天におられる神ではありませんか？あなたは諸国のすべての王国を治めておられます。あなたの手には力と勢いがあり、だれもあなたに逆らうことはできません。
ja.R: ヨシャファトは祈りました。「わたしたちの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは天におられる神です。あなたは、世界のすべての国々を治めておられます。あなたは強く、力のある方です。だれも、あなたに逆らうことはできません。

uk.L: І сказав він: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наших батьків, хіба не {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} Бог на небесах? І {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} пануєш над усіма царствами народів, і в {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} руці сила й могутність, і немає нікого, хто встояв би проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.B: Він сказав: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наших предків, хіба не {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} Бог на небі? Ти пануєш над кожним царством народів. У {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} руці сила й могутність, і ніхто не може встояти проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: Він молився: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наших предків, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — Бог на небі. Ти правиш над усіма царствами народів. Ти сильний і могутній, і ніхто не може встояти проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: are you not God in heaven?: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The question is a confession of faith: Yahweh is the God who rules from heaven. The prayer opens by stating who God is before it states the need.

decisions.choice: in your hand are power and might: the words of David's prayer
decisions.reason: David praised Yahweh with the same words when the people gave for the temple (1 Chronicles 29:11-12). Jehoshaphat calls on the same God who rules over all.

decisions.choice: you rule over all the kingdoms of the nations: the invading nations are under God's rule
decisions.reason: Moab, Ammon and Seir are among the kingdoms Yahweh rules. No army can stand against him, so the danger is not beyond his power.

decisions.choice: there is no one to stand against you: no one can resist you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "there is not with you to take a stand". "With" here means "against" (as in 14:10), and the verb is used of standing one's ground in battle.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable states what the question means (m1). It says "strong and mighty" for "power and might in your hand".

decisions.choice: "SEÑOR" without article; "Dios de nuestros padres" (L); "Dios de nuestros antepasados" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The vocative divine name takes no article, as in Kings; Balanced and Readable say "antepasados" for "fathers", as the English says "ancestors".

decisions.choice: "tu" to God, with deity_pronoun spans on "tu", "toi", "te", "ta"
decisions.reason: God is addressed with "tu", as in the Psalms and in Solomon's prayer; French needs spans on object pronouns ("te") that English carries in "you".

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns only (wewe, mwako, yako)
alternatives: a span on every "you" as in English
decisions.reason: Swahili marks "you" inside the verb (unatawala), and a verb prefix cannot take a capital, so this prayer has fewer deity_pronoun spans than the English; sentence-initial "Wewe" is written with its capital plainly.

decisions.choice: "Lạy CHÚA"; the king calls God "Ngài" and the people "chúng con"
decisions.reason: The prayer form of the earlier notes: the one who prays says "con", "chúng con" before God.

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat prays in 합쇼체, calling God "주님" and the people "저희"; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As in Solomon's and Hezekiah's prayers in Kings. Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change; respect is carried by 주님 and the honorific -시-, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: tu, with deity_pronoun spans (verses 6-12); SENHOR without the article in the vocative
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat prays with "tu", as Solomon does in chapter 6 in Portuguese, every pronoun for God under the deity_pronoun span; a sentence that opens with "Tu" is written plainly with its capital. The name in the vocative has no article.

decisions.choice: na tua mão [estão] a força e o poder
decisions.reason: The words of David's prayer (m2) keep the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 29:12, "na tua mão [estão] a força e o poder", so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: the prayer says "አንተ" to God; God in heaven "በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ"; the nations (goyim) "ሕዝቦች"
decisions.reason: Prayer to God uses "አንተ" (settled); Elohim as a predicate is "አምላክ"; goyim are "ሕዝቦች" by the Joshua to 2 Samuel list.

decisions.choice: "तू" in Jehoshaphat's prayer; no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: People praying to God say तू (Pentateuch note). The Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7); the prayer's pronouns carry none through verse 12.

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat's prayer (20:6-12) is in です・ます at every level, God addressed as "あなた" with respect forms ("治めておられます", "与えてくださいました"), as David's prayer in 2 Samuel 7.
decisions.reason: People speaking to God use です・ます in the house style.

source.text: הֲלֹ֣א׀אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הוֹרַ֨שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִלִּפְנֵ֖י עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽתִּתְּנָ֗הּ לְזֶ֛רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹֽהַבְךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [Did] not you, our God, dispossess [the] inhabitants of the land the this from before your people Israel, and you gave it to [the] offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

en.L: Did {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} friend forever?
en.B: Our God, was it not {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who drove out the people living in this land as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel came in, and gave it for all time to the descendants of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} friend Abraham?
en.R: You are our God. You drove out the people who lived in this land so that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel could have it. You gave it forever to the descendants of Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} friend.

es.L: ¿No fuiste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Dios nuestro, quien echó a los habitantes de esta tierra de delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel, y la diste a la descendencia de Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amigo, para siempre?
es.B: Dios nuestro, ¿no fuiste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quien expulsó a los habitantes de esta tierra cuando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel entraba en ella, y se la diste para siempre a los descendientes de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amigo Abraham?
es.R: Tú eres nuestro Dios. Tú echaste a la gente que vivía en esta tierra para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel la tuviera. Se la diste para siempre a los descendientes de Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amigo.

fr.L: N’est-ce pas {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, notre Dieu, qui as dépossédé les habitants de ce pays devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, et qui l’as donné à la descendance d’Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} ami, pour toujours ?
fr.B: Notre Dieu, n’est-ce pas {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as chassé les habitants de ce pays devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, et qui l’as donné pour toujours aux descendants d’Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} ami ?
fr.R: Tu es notre Dieu. Tu as chassé les gens qui habitaient ce pays pour que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël puisse l’avoir. Tu l’as donné pour toujours aux descendants d’Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} ami.

sw.L: Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu wetu, hukuwafukuza wenyeji wa nchi hii mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli, ukaipa uzao wa Abrahamu rafiki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} milele?
sw.B: Ee Mungu wetu, je, si {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyewafukuza watu walioishi katika nchi hii watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli walipoingia, ukaipa wazao wa rafiki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} Abrahamu iwe yao daima?
sw.R: Wewe ni Mungu wetu. Uliwafukuza watu walioishi katika nchi hii ili watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli waimiliki. Uliwapa wazao wa Abrahamu, rafiki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nchi hii milele.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời chúng con, chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi dân cư xứ này khỏi trước mặt Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và ban xứ ấy cho dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham, bạn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mãi mãi sao?
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời chúng con, chẳng phải chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi dân cư xứ này đi khi Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tiến vào, và ban xứ ấy đời đời cho dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham, bạn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sao?
vi.R: Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con. Ngài đã đuổi dân sống trong xứ này đi để Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được ở. Ngài đã ban xứ này mãi mãi cho dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham, bạn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저희 하나님, 주님께서 이 땅의 주민들을 주님의 백성 이스라엘 앞에서 쫓아내시고, 그 땅을 주님의 벗 아브라함의 자손에게 영원히 주지 않으셨습니까?
ko.B: 저희 하나님, 이 땅에 살던 사람들을 주님의 백성 이스라엘 앞에서 쫓아내시고, 이 땅을 주님의 벗 아브라함의 자손에게 영원히 주신 분이 주님이 아니십니까?
ko.R: 주님은 저희의 하나님이십니다. 주님께서는 이 땅에 살던 사람들을 쫓아내셔서, 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 이 땅을 차지하게 하셨습니다. 그리고 이 땅을 주님의 친구 아브라함의 자손에게 영원히 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Não expulsaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, nosso Deus, os habitantes desta terra de diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel, e não a deste para sempre à descendência de Abraão, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amigo?
pt.B: Nosso Deus, não foste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que expulsaste os habitantes desta terra diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel, e a deste para sempre aos descendentes de Abraão, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amigo?
pt.R: Tu és o nosso Deus. Tu expulsaste o povo que morava nesta terra, para que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel ficasse com ela. Tu a deste para sempre aos descendentes de Abraão, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amigo.

am.L: አምላካችን ሆይ፣ አንተ የዚችን ምድር ነዋሪዎች ከሕዝብህ ከእስራኤል ፊት አላስወጣህምን? ለወዳጅህም ለአብርሃም ዘር ለዘላለም አልሰጠሃትምን?
am.B: አምላካችን ሆይ፣ ሕዝብህ እስራኤል በገባ ጊዜ በዚህች ምድር የሚኖሩትን ያስወጣሃቸው፣ ምድሪቱንም ለወዳጅህ ለአብርሃም ዘሮች ለዘላለም የሰጠሃቸው አንተ አይደለህምን?
am.R: አንተ አምላካችን ነህ። ሕዝብህ እስራኤል እንዲወርሳት በዚህች ምድር ይኖሩ የነበሩትን አስወጣሃቸው። ለወዳጅህ ለአብርሃም ዘሮችም ለዘላለም ሰጠሃት።

hi.L: हे हमारे परमेश्वर, क्या तूने इस देश के निवासियों को अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल के सामने से निकालकर, यह देश अपने मित्र अब्राहम के वंश को सदा के लिए नहीं दे दिया?
hi.B: हे हमारे परमेश्वर, क्या तू ही नहीं था जिसने अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल के आते समय इस देश के निवासियों को निकाल दिया, और यह देश अपने मित्र अब्राहम के वंशजों को सदा के लिए दे दिया?
hi.R: तू हमारा परमेश्वर है। तूने उन लोगों को निकाल दिया जो इस देश में रहते थे, ताकि तेरी प्रजा इस्राएल इसे पा सके। तूने यह देश सदा के लिए अपने मित्र अब्राहम के वंशजों को दे दिया।

ru.L: Не {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ли, наш Бог, изгнал жителей этой земли перед {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} народом Израилем и дал её потомству Авраама, {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} друга, навеки?
ru.B: Наш Бог, разве не {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} изгнал жителей этой земли, когда входил {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ Израиль, и навсегда отдал её потомкам {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} друга Авраама?
ru.R: Ты наш Бог. Ты прогнал народы, которые жили в этой земле, чтобы она досталась {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} народу Израилю. Ты навсегда отдал её потомкам Авраама, {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} друга.

ja.L: わたしたちの神よ、あなたは、この地の住民をあなたの民イスラエルの前から追い払い、それをあなたの友アブラハムの子孫に、とこしえに与えられたではありませんか？
ja.B: わたしたちの神よ、この地に住んでいた人々を、あなたの民イスラエルの前から追い払い、この地をあなたの友アブラハムの子孫に永遠に与えられたのは、あなたではありませんか？
ja.R: あなたは、わたしたちの神です。あなたは、この地に住んでいた人々を追い出して、あなたの民イスラエルが住めるようにしてくださいました。そして、この地を、あなたの友アブラハムの子孫に、いつまでも与えてくださいました。

uk.L: Хіба не {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, наш Боже, вигнав мешканців цієї землі перед {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} народом Ізраїлем і дав її нащадкам Авраама, {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} друга, навіки?
uk.B: Наш Боже, хіба не {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вигнав людей, що жили в цій землі, коли входив {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ Ізраїль, і дав її навіки нащадкам {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} друга Авраама?
uk.R: Ти наш Бог. Ти вигнав людей, що жили в цій землі, щоб {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} народ Ізраїль міг її мати. Ти дав її навіки нащадкам Авраама, {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} друга.

decisions.choice: did you not ...?: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, the question recalls what everyone knows to be true: God gave Israel this land.

decisions.choice: Abraham your friend: as in Isaiah 41:8
decisions.reason: God calls Israel "the offspring of Abraham, my friend" in Isaiah 41:8. The Hebrew word means "the one who loves you"; it speaks of the close bond God made with Abraham. The land was promised to him and his offspring (Genesis 12:7; 13:15).

decisions.choice: drive out: dispossess
decisions.reason: The verb means to take possession by driving out the people who held the land (Deuteronomy 9:3-5).

decisions.choice: forever: the gift was for all time
decisions.reason: "Forever" goes with the gift of the land: it was given to Abraham's offspring for all time (Genesis 13:15). The invaders now threaten that gift (verse 11).

decisions.choice: statements instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable states what the question means (m1), as in verse 6.

decisions.choice: Abraham your friend "ወዳጅህ አብርሃም", as James 2:23 calls him "የእግዚአብሔር ወዳጅ"
decisions.reason: The New Testament's Amharic for the same title keeps the echo.

decisions.choice: "अपने मित्र अब्राहम"
decisions.reason: Abraham God's friend (meaning m2), with the plain word for friend.

decisions.choice: "あなたの友アブラハム" at every level, as the English.
alternatives: あなたを愛するアブラハム
decisions.reason: The participle "the one who loves you" is the Bible's title "friend of God" (James 2:23, Japanese "神の友").

source.text: וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ־בָ֑הּ וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לְךָ֧׀בָּ֛הּ מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they dwelt in it, and they built for you in it a sanctuary for your name, saying,

en.L: And they lived in it, and they built {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a sanctuary in it for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, saying,
en.B: They have lived in it and built {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a sanctuary in it for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, saying,
en.R: They have lived in this land. They built a temple in it to honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and they said,

es.L: Y habitaron en ella, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} edificaron en ella un santuario para {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, diciendo:
es.B: Ellos han vivido en ella y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han edificado en ella un santuario para {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, diciendo:
es.R: Ellos han vivido en esta tierra. Construyeron en ella un templo para honrar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, y dijeron:

fr.L: Et ils y ont habité, et ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}y ont bâti un sanctuaire pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, en disant :
fr.B: Ils y ont habité et ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}y ont bâti un sanctuaire pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, en disant :
fr.R: Ils ont habité dans ce pays. Ils y ont construit un temple pour honorer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et ils ont dit :

sw.L: Nao wakakaa ndani yake, wakakujengea ndani yake patakatifu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, wakisema,
sw.B: Wamekaa ndani yake, nao wamekujengea humo patakatifu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, wakisema,
sw.R: Wameishi katika nchi hii. Walijenga humo hekalu ili kuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, wakasema,

vi.L: Họ đã ở trong xứ ấy, và đã xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong đó một nơi thánh vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mà rằng:
vi.B: Họ đã sống trong xứ ấy và xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một nơi thánh tại đó vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mà nói rằng:
vi.R: Họ đã sống trong xứ này. Họ đã xây tại đây một đền thờ để tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ đã nói:

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 거기에 살면서, 거기에 주님의 이름을 위하여 주님께 성소를 지어 드리고 말했습니다.
ko.B: 그들은 이 땅에 살면서 주님의 이름을 위하여 이곳에 성소를 지어 드리고 이렇게 말했습니다.
ko.R: 그들은 이 땅에서 살아왔습니다. 그들은 주님의 이름을 높이려고 이 땅에 성전을 짓고 이렇게 말했습니다.

pt.L: E habitaram nela, e edificaram nela para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} um santuário para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, dizendo:
pt.B: Eles habitaram nela e construíram nela um santuário para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, dizendo:
pt.R: Eles viveram nesta terra. Construíram nela um templo para honrar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, e disseram:

am.L: በእርሷም ተቀመጡ፤ ለስምህም በእርሷ መቅደስ ሠሩልህ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦
am.B: በእርሷ ኖረዋል፤ ለስምህም በእርሷ መቅደስ ሠርተውልሃል፤ እንዲህም ብለዋል፦
am.R: በዚህች ምድር ኖረዋል። ስምህን ለማክበር ቤተ መቅደስ ሠሩባት፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦

hi.L: और वे उसमें बस गए, और उन्होंने उसमें तेरे लिए तेरे नाम का एक पवित्रस्थान बनाया, और कहा,
hi.B: वे उसमें बस गए हैं और उन्होंने उसमें तेरे नाम के लिए एक पवित्रस्थान बनाया है, और कहा है,
hi.R: वे इस देश में रहते आए हैं। उन्होंने यहाँ तेरे नाम के आदर के लिए एक पवित्रस्थान बनाया, और उन्होंने कहा,

ru.L: И поселились они в ней, и построили {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в ней святилище для {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени, говоря:
ru.B: Они поселились в ней и построили в ней {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} святилище для {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени, говоря:
ru.R: Они поселились в этой земле. Они построили в ней храм, чтобы прославить {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, и сказали:

ja.L: そして彼らはそこに住み、そこにあなたのために、あなたの名のための聖所を建てて、言いました。
ja.B: 彼らはそこに住み、あなたの名のために、そこに聖所を建てて、こう言いました。
ja.R: 彼らはこの地に住みました。そして、あなたの名をたたえるために、ここに神殿を建てました。そして、こう言いました。

uk.L: І вони жили в ній, і збудували {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} в ній святилище для {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені, кажучи:
uk.B: Вони жили в ній і збудували {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} в ній святилище для {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені, кажучи:
uk.R: Вони жили в цій землі. Вони збудували в ній храм на честь {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені і сказали:

decisions.choice: a sanctuary: the temple, the holy place
decisions.reason: The word means a holy place. Here it is the temple built by Solomon (1 Chronicles 22:19; 28:10).

decisions.choice: for your name: the place where God is known and called on
decisions.reason: Yahweh chose the temple as the place for his name, where his people could call on him (6:20; 7:16).

decisions.choice: saying: the prayer of verse 9 is what they said when they built it
decisions.reason: "Saying" introduces words the builders spoke, which sum up Solomon's prayer at the dedication (6:28-30, 34-35). The sentence runs on into verse 9.

decisions.choice: a temple to honor your name
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "sanctuary" and explains "for your name" (m2).

decisions.choice: passé composé "ont habité ... ont bâti" in the prayer
decisions.reason: The verse is speech addressed to God, so French uses the tense of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: "पवित्रस्थान" at every level
decisions.reason: The sanctuary is the temple (meaning m1); "पवित्रस्थान" as the Pentateuch note, at Readable too, since "मंदिर" is kept for the Hebrew hekhal.

source.text: אִם־תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜ינוּ רָעָ֗ה חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְדֶ֣בֶר וְרָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֨יהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וּלְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְךָ֖ בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצָּרָתֵ֖נוּ וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע וְתוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: If comes upon us calamity, sword, judgment, or pestilence or famine, we will stand before the house the this and before you, for your name [is] in the house the this, and we will cry out to you from our distress, and you will hear and save.

en.L: 'If calamity comes upon us, sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house and before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name [is] in this house, and we will cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} from our distress, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will hear and save.'
en.B: 'If disaster comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or disease, or famine, we will stand before this house and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence, since this house bears {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. We will cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in our trouble, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will hear and save us.'
en.R: 'Trouble may come on us. War may come as a punishment, or disease, or hunger. Then we will stand in front of this temple and before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is here in this temple. We will cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in our trouble, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will hear us and rescue us.'

es.L: “Si viene sobre nosotros el mal, espada, juicio, o peste, o hambre, nos presentaremos delante de esta casa y delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre [está] en esta casa, y clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} desde nuestra angustia, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} oirás y salvarás”.
es.B: “Si nos sobreviene una desgracia, sea la espada del juicio, la peste o el hambre, nos presentaremos delante de esta casa y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia, pues esta casa lleva {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en nuestra angustia, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nos oirás y nos salvarás”.
es.R: “Puede que nos venga una desgracia. Puede venir la guerra como castigo, o una enfermedad, o el hambre. Entonces nos pondremos de pie frente a este templo y delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre está aquí, en este templo. Clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en nuestra angustia, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nos oirás y nos rescatarás”.

fr.L: “Si un malheur vient sur nous, épée, jugement, ou peste, ou famine, nous nous tiendrons devant cette maison et devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom [est] dans cette maison, et nous crierons vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} du fond de notre détresse, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} entendras et sauveras.”
fr.B: “Si un malheur vient sur nous, que ce soit l’épée du jugement, la peste ou la famine, nous nous tiendrons devant cette maison et devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, car cette maison porte {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Nous crierons vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans notre détresse, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} entendras et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous sauveras.”
fr.R: “Un malheur peut nous arriver. La guerre peut venir comme une punition, ou bien la maladie, ou la faim. Alors nous nous tiendrons devant ce temple et devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est ici, dans ce temple. Nous crierons vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans notre malheur, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous écouteras et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous sauveras.”

sw.L: 'Msiba ukitujia, upanga, hukumu, au tauni, au njaa, tutasimama mbele ya nyumba hii na mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa maana jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [limo] katika nyumba hii, nasi tutakulilia katika dhiki yetu, nawe utasikia na kuokoa.'
sw.B: 'Msiba ukitujia, uwe upanga wa hukumu, au tauni, au njaa, tutasimama mbele ya nyumba hii na mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa kuwa nyumba hii inaitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Tutakulilia katika taabu yetu, nawe utasikia na kutuokoa.'
sw.R: 'Huenda taabu ikatujia. Vita vinaweza kuja kama adhabu, au ugonjwa, au njaa. Hapo tutasimama mbele ya hekalu hili na mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa sababu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liko hapa katika hekalu hili. Tutakulilia katika taabu yetu, nawe utatusikia na kutuokoa.'

vi.L: 'Nếu tai họa giáng trên chúng con, gươm giáo, sự đoán phạt, hoặc dịch bệnh, hoặc nạn đói, chúng con sẽ đứng trước đền này và trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trong đền này, và chúng con sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ trong cơn hoạn nạn, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghe và giải cứu.'
vi.B: 'Nếu tai họa giáng trên chúng con, dù là gươm giáo đoán phạt, dịch bệnh hay nạn đói, chúng con sẽ đứng trước đền này và trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì đền này mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng con sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong cơn hoạn nạn, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghe và giải cứu chúng con.'
vi.R: 'Có thể tai họa sẽ đến trên chúng con. Có thể chiến tranh đến như một sự trừng phạt, hoặc bệnh dịch, hoặc đói kém. Khi ấy chúng con sẽ đứng trước đền thờ này và trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trong đền thờ này. Chúng con sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong cơn khốn khó, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghe và cứu chúng con.'

ko.L: '만일 재앙이, 칼이, 심판이, 또는 전염병이나 기근이 저희에게 닥치면, 저희가 이 집 앞에, 그리고 주님 앞에 서겠습니다. 주님의 이름이 이 집에 [있기] 때문입니다. 그리고 저희가 저희의 고난 가운데서 주님께 부르짖으면, 주님께서 들으시고 구원하실 것입니다.'
ko.B: '재앙이 저희에게 닥치면, 그것이 심판의 칼이든 전염병이든 기근이든, 저희가 이 집 앞에, 곧 주님 앞에 서겠습니다. 이 집에는 주님의 이름이 있기 때문입니다. 저희가 고난 가운데서 주님께 부르짖으면, 주님께서 들으시고 저희를 구원하실 것입니다.'
ko.R: '저희에게 어려운 일이 닥칠 수 있습니다. 벌로 전쟁이 일어나거나, 병이 돌거나, 굶주림이 닥칠 수도 있습니다. 그러면 저희가 이 성전 앞에, 그리고 주님 앞에 서겠습니다. 주님의 이름이 이 성전에 있기 때문입니다. 저희가 어려움 가운데서 주님께 부르짖으면, 주님께서 들으시고 저희를 구해 주실 것입니다.'

pt.L: 'Se vier sobre nós o mal, espada, juízo, ou peste, ou fome, nós nos poremos diante desta casa e diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, pois o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome [está] nesta casa, e clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} da nossa angústia, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ouvirás e salvarás.'
pt.B: 'Se vier sobre nós alguma desgraça, seja a espada do juízo, seja a peste, seja a fome, nós nos poremos diante desta casa e na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença, pois esta casa leva o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome. Clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} na nossa aflição, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos ouvirás e nos salvarás.'
pt.R: 'Pode ser que venha sobre nós alguma desgraça. Pode vir a guerra como castigo, ou doença, ou fome. Então ficaremos de pé diante deste templo e diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome está aqui neste templo. Clamaremos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} no nosso sofrimento, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos ouvirás e nos salvarás.'

am.L: “ክፉ ነገር፣ ሰይፍ፣ ፍርድ፣ ቸነፈር ወይም ራብ ቢመጣብን፣ በዚህ ቤት ፊትና በፊትህ እንቆማለን፤ ስምህ በዚህ ቤት ነውና፤ በመከራችንም ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፤ አንተም ትሰማለህ፤ ታድናለህም።”
am.B: “ጥፋት፣ የፍርድ ሰይፍ፣ ቸነፈር ወይም ራብ ቢመጣብን፣ በዚህ ቤት ፊትና በፊትህ እንቆማለን፤ ይህ ቤት ስምህን ተሸክሟልና። በመከራችንም ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፤ አንተም ሰምተህ ታድነናለህ።”
am.R: “መከራ ሊመጣብን ይችላል። ጦርነት እንደ ቅጣት ሊመጣ ይችላል፤ ወይም በሽታ፣ ወይም ራብ። በዚያን ጊዜ በዚህ ቤተ መቅደስ ፊትና በፊትህ እንቆማለን፤ ስምህ በዚህ ቤተ መቅደስ ነውና። በመከራችን ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፤ አንተም ትሰማናለህ፤ ታድነናለህም።”

hi.L: 'यदि हम पर विपत्ति आए, तलवार, दंड, या महामारी, या अकाल, तो हम इस भवन के सामने और तेरे सामने खड़े होंगे, क्योंकि तेरा नाम इस भवन में [है], और हम अपने संकट में तेरी दोहाई देंगे, और तू सुनकर बचाएगा।'
hi.B: 'यदि हम पर विपत्ति आए, चाहे न्याय की तलवार हो, या महामारी, या अकाल, तो हम इस भवन के सामने और तेरे सामने खड़े होंगे, क्योंकि यह भवन तेरे नाम का है। हम अपने संकट में तेरी दोहाई देंगे, और तू सुनकर हमें बचाएगा।'
hi.R: 'हम पर विपत्ति आ सकती है। दंड के रूप में युद्ध आ सकता है, या बीमारी, या भूख। तब हम इस भवन के सामने और तेरे सामने खड़े होंगे, क्योंकि तेरा नाम यहाँ इस भवन में है। हम अपने संकट में तेरी दोहाई देंगे, और तू हमारी सुनकर हमें छुड़ाएगा।'

ru.L: “Если придёт на нас беда, меч, суд, или мор, или голод, мы встанем перед этим домом и перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя в этом доме, и воззовём к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} из нашей скорби, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} услышишь и спасёшь.”
ru.B: “Если придёт на нас беда — меч наказания, или мор, или голод, — мы встанем перед этим домом и перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, ведь этот дом носит {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя. Мы воззовём к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в нашей беде, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} услышишь и спасёшь нас.”
ru.R: “На нас может прийти беда. Может прийти война как наказание, или болезнь, или голод. Тогда мы встанем перед этим храмом и перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя здесь, в этом храме. Мы будем взывать к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в нашей беде, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} услышишь нас и спасёшь.”

ja.L: 『もし災いがわたしたちに臨むなら、剣、裁き、あるいは疫病、あるいは飢饉が[臨むなら]、わたしたちはこの家の前に、あなたの前に立ちます。あなたの名がこの家にあるからです。そしてわたしたちは苦しみの中からあなたに叫び求めます。そうすれば、あなたは聞いて、救ってくださいます。』
ja.B: 『もし、わたしたちに災いが臨むなら、裁きの剣であれ、疫病であれ、飢饉であれ、わたしたちはこの家の前に、あなたの御前に立ちます。この家にはあなたの名があるからです。わたしたちが苦しみの中からあなたに叫び求めるなら、あなたは聞いて、わたしたちを救ってくださいます。』
ja.R: 『わたしたちに苦しみが来るかもしれません。罰として戦争が起こったり、病気がはやったり、ききんが起こったりするかもしれません。そのときは、わたしたちはこの神殿の前に、あなたの前に立ちます。あなたの名が、この神殿にあるからです。わたしたちは苦しみの中から、あなたに叫び求めます。そうすれば、あなたは聞いて、わたしたちを救ってくださいます。』

uk.L: “Якщо прийде на нас лихо, меч, суд, чи мор, чи голод, ми станемо перед цим домом і перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя [є] в цьому домі, і будемо кликати до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} з нашої біди, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} почуєш і спасеш.”
uk.B: “Якщо на нас прийде лихо, чи меч суду, чи хвороба, чи голод, ми станемо перед цим домом і перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, бо цей дім носить {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя. Ми кликатимемо до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в нашій біді, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} почуєш і спасеш нас.”
uk.R: “На нас може прийти біда. Може прийти війна як покарання, або хвороба, або голод. Тоді ми станемо перед цим храмом і перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя тут, у цьому храмі. Ми кликатимемо до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в нашій біді, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} почуєш нас і врятуєш нас.”

decisions.choice: if disaster comes upon us ...: Solomon's prayer in brief
decisions.reason: The words sum up Solomon's prayer at the dedication of the temple: sword, plague and famine (6:24-30), and the promise that God would hear prayer made toward the house where his name is (6:20; 7:13-15).

decisions.choice: sword, judgment: the sword as God's judgment, or two separate troubles
alternatives: sword, judgment, pestilence or famine (four troubles)
decisions.reason: The two words stand side by side with no "and" between them. They may mean "the sword of judgment", war sent as a punishment, or "sword" and "judgment" as two of the troubles in the list. The meaning is much the same either way.

decisions.choice: pestilence: deadly disease, plague
decisions.reason: The word names a deadly epidemic, one of the judgments of the covenant (Leviticus 26:25; 2 Chronicles 7:13).

decisions.choice: you will hear and save: the expected answer
decisions.reason: The verbs are the people's confident expectation, based on God's promise (7:14-15).

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: These are words the builders said (verse 8), quoted inside Jehoshaphat's prayer, so they take single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: several short sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long "if ... then" sentence into shorter sentences.

decisions.choice: inner quotation marks “ ”
decisions.reason: The builders' words quoted inside Jehoshaphat's prayer take the second level of Spanish quotation marks, as the English uses single marks.

decisions.choice: inner quotation marks “ ”
decisions.reason: The builders' words are quoted inside Jehoshaphat's prayer, which already stands in « »; French uses “ ” for the inner quotation, as the English uses single marks.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks inside the prayer
decisions.reason: As the English: words the builders said, quoted inside Jehoshaphat's prayer.

decisions.choice: a peste (L, B); doença (R)
decisions.reason: "Peste" is the word for a deadly epidemic sent as a judgment (m3), kept apart from the "praga" of 6:28-29 in Portuguese; Readable says "doença", as the English "disease". The words the builders said are in single quotation marks inside the prayer, as in the English.

decisions.choice: pestilence "ቸነፈር" (Literal, Balanced, as settled), "በሽታ" (Readable); the quotation inside the prayer in "“ ”", where the English has single marks
decisions.reason: The settled word for deadly disease; the quoted words of the temple builders are a quotation within Jehoshaphat's prayer.

decisions.choice: The words quoted inside the prayer in 『 』; "剣、裁き" kept as two words at Literal, "裁きの剣" (B) and "罰として戦争" (R) as the English reading.
decisions.reason: A quotation inside speech takes 『 』; the sense of "sword, judgment" is uncertain and the levels follow the English.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּה֩ בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֨וֹן וּמוֹאָ֜ב וְהַר־שֵׂעִ֗יר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־נָתַ֤תָּה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָב֣וֹא בָהֶ֔ם בְּבֹאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֛י סָ֥רוּ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א הִשְׁמִידֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, behold, [the] sons of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom not you let Israel to go into them when they came from [the] land of Egypt, for they turned aside from them and not destroyed them,

en.L: And now, see, the sons of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not let Israel invade when they came from the land of Egypt, for they turned aside from them and did not destroy them,
en.B: But now look at the people of Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir. You would not let Israel invade them when Israel came out of the land of Egypt, so Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them,
en.R: Now look at the armies of Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir. When our people came out of Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not let them attack these nations. So Israel went around them and did not destroy them.

es.L: Y ahora, he aquí los hijos de Amón y de Moab y del monte Seír, a quienes no {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dejaste que Israel invadiera cuando venían de la tierra de Egipto, sino que se apartaron de ellos y no los destruyeron;
es.B: Pero ahora mira a la gente de Amón, de Moab y del monte Seír. Tú no dejaste que Israel los invadiera cuando salió de la tierra de Egipto; por eso Israel se apartó de ellos y no los destruyó;
es.R: Ahora mira a los ejércitos de Amón, de Moab y del monte Seír. Cuando nuestro pueblo salió de Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no lo dejaste atacar a estas naciones. Por eso Israel pasó de largo y no las destruyó.

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici les fils d’Ammon et de Moab et de la montagne de Séir, chez qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas permis à Israël d’entrer quand ils venaient du pays d’Égypte, car ils se sont détournés d’eux et ne les ont pas détruits,
